name: leakfa-breaches
title: Leakfa breached Iranian sites
changes: reduced to domain and the site's English and Persian names; descriptions, related links and company-response ratings dropped; four global platforms dropped

licence.name: MIT
licence.source: LICENSE on the domains branch of Leakfarsi/Leakfa-Alert, the branch whose only content is leaks.json: the MIT text, "Copyright (c) 2026 Leakfa", since the branch's first commit cfff97a (2026-07-02). The main branch carries the same LICENSE and both READMEs say the project is released under MIT. Read on 2026-11-08.

checks.licenceStated: LICENSE on the domains branch (SHA-256 6a9010e2d580692e9d520a1c80b54dd537c8ab444224b70ef450e65ca53887cc at commit e38bd2a): MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Leakfa. No header in the JSON, no other terms in the repository. Leakfa's own extension downloads this file from the same branch, so the data is the licensed work.
checks.licenceAccepted: MIT is on the accepted set.
checks.notRefused: No NonCommercial or NoDerivatives term, nothing forbids redistribution or restricts the audience. Care: MIT asks that the copyright and permission notice go with every copy, so the MIT text ships beside the converted file and in CPAB-Lists. Care: the descriptions might paraphrase third-party reporting, so CPAB ships none of them; domains and site names are facts within Leakfa's grant.
checks.attribution: Leakfa (https://leakfa.com/), with a link, on the popup's source line, in the switch description, in the credits and in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
checks.aggregated: Not an aggregate of other lists: Leakfa's own catalogue of incidents it reported. relatedURL fields point only to Leakfa's own workers.dev pages (61 to extension.leakfarsi.workers.dev/leaks, 40 to telegram.leakfarsi.workers.dev mirrors of its channel); those pages could not be read through Cloudflare's challenge, so CPAB ships no relatedURL and links one fixed page instead.
checks.ownFile: The reduced data is one file of its own, rules/leakfa-breaches.json, never merged with the HIBP file, under MIT with LICENSE.MIT-Leakfa.txt beside it.
checks.retrievable: Fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the newest commit that changed leaks.json on the domains branch, recorded as listCommit; the file's own timestamp field is stale and not used.
